Hero_Desc_ErpinRoyale:
Erpin has grown into the true queen of the sprites.
Leaving her immature past behind, she resolves to step forward for the precious people of the Sprite Kingdom.
She is still clumsy at times, but her devotion to everyone will never falter.
Album_Like_ErpinRoyale: Praise from Master and Ner, strawberry cake
Album_Hate_ErpinRoyale: Villains who threaten the Sprite Kingdom, overly bitter food
Album_Wish_ErpinRoyale: To make everyone happy as queen of the Sprite Kingdom
Album_ErpinRoyale1: Our immature Erpin has grown into the true queen of the Sprite Kingdom. She is still inexperienced and retains a childish side, but her gentle heart has become stronger and more steadfast.
Album_ErpinRoyale2: The sprites, who once treated Erpin as little more than a figurehead, seem to be changing their attitude toward her little by little. Escaping her old image will not be easy, but at least her sincere devotion to the Sprite Kingdom appears to have reached them.
Album_ErpinRoyale3: Recently, Erpin has personally hosted meetings among the leaders of Elias's races. According to Ner, they are meetings in name only and resemble tea parties where everyone gathers to share snacks. Still, it is good that they get along... I should attend now and then to remind them of the original purpose.
Album_ErpinRoyale4: To overcome her picky eating, Erpin has asked Ricota to prepare varied menus. After forcing herself to keep eating, she found some dishes reasonably enjoyable. Even so, it seems she still cannot resist a sprite's instinctive attraction to sweets.
Album_ErpinRoyale5: Erpin has recently been learning how to bake cakes from Ashur. She says she feels bad always receiving them and thinks making them herself could be fun. I never imagined I would hear that from Erpin, who once found everything bothersome...
Album_ErpinRoyale6: Erpin has been studying dictation diligently and writing in her diary every day, so Ner scolds her far less often. Although happy, Erpin says she also feels a strange sense that Ner is growing a little more distant. I told her that with less time spent being scolded, they could spend more happy time together instead. She nodded brightly and cheered up.
Album_ErpinRoyale7: Erpin has gained confidence through many experiences, yet she still sometimes doubts whether she is truly fulfilling her duties as queen. I do not know exactly what makes a true queen or gives a leader dignity either... but I intend to learn alongside Erpin. It may take a long time, but we will keep holding hands and face it together.
LoveHero_ErpinRoyale: Hehe, Master! We are going everywhere together!
LoveHeroCancel_ErpinRoyale: Hmph! I still want to stay with you longer!
Food_ChefNote_ErpinRoyale_Hate1: She likes the refreshing aroma, but dislikes the sharp taste because it makes her feel as though she is brushing her teeth.
Food_ChefNote_ErpinRoyale_Hate2: Erpin is trying to overcome her picky eating, but this is the one dish she still avoids. She says it is not mere pickiness; her instincts reject it.
Food_ChefNote_ErpinRoyale_Like1: Erpin still loves strawberry cake most of all, saying it is the food that best represents her.
Food_ChefNote_ErpinRoyale_Like10: Erpin asked whether eating this would give her the energy to protect everyone, then devoured the entire dish at once.
Food_ChefNote_ErpinRoyale_Like2: She says it is sweet and disappears quickly in her mouth, so she always ends up eating a lot. I should make sure Erpin does not overindulge.
Food_ChefNote_ErpinRoyale_Like3: She eats it happily, saying she has finally discovered the appeal of food that is not sweet. The piping-hot broth seems to be her favorite part.
Food_ChefNote_ErpinRoyale_Like4: She enjoys the flavor, but also loves its pretty log shape. She suggested making more food like this, so I should give it some thought.
Food_ChefNote_ErpinRoyale_Like5: She says it is deliciously sweet and tart, but there is not enough of it. When serving Erpin, I should put several in one cup.
Food_ChefNote_ErpinRoyale_Like6: She used to like only the honey inside, but now she enjoys the rice cake as well. She says she likes its tender, chewy texture.
Food_ChefNote_ErpinRoyale_Like7: She says that when she eats them one by one, the plate is empty before she knows it. Rather than letting them melt, she prefers crunching through them.
Food_ChefNote_ErpinRoyale_Like8: Erpin says eating this dish reminds her of the old days. Its aroma resembles one she often smelled back then.
Food_ChefNote_ErpinRoyale_Like9: She likes how every color has a different flavor, saying it is fun because they remind her of the many races of Elias.

ErpinRoyale_Spawn1: I will not stand by any longer. Let us go!
ErpinRoyale_Spawn2: Everyone! I will protect you now!
ErpinRoyale_Growth1: I wonder... Have I changed, even a little?

ErpinRoyale_Victory1: Yahoo! I am glad we won. Right?
ErpinRoyale_Victory2: Now no one will be in danger!
ErpinRoyale_Defeat1: Did cutting back on snacks... make me weaker?!
ErpinRoyale_Defeat2: Let us try again! I have to fix this~!

ErpinRoyale_Affinity1_2: You want to know if I still feel like running away sometimes? Can you ask me that when Ner is not around?
ErpinRoyale_Affinity2: I am about to go hand out bread. Want to come with me?
ErpinRoyale_Affinity1_3: If there is something you cannot solve with your fists, you should consider whether your fists were simply too weak. I speak from experience!
ErpinRoyale_Affinity3: Where do you go for brunch, afternoon lunch, and late-night snacks? Let us eat all six meals together, Master!
ErpinRoyale_Affinity4: Do you ever feel lonely, Master? I think I would be lonely if there were no other Sprites in the world but me.
ErpinRoyale_Affinity5: Since I eat bread less often now, I have to eat better bread with every meal. Let us go to Ashur's!
ErpinRoyale_Affinity6: Polan said that if the world were not peaceful, I would have become an overlord. But I still like a peaceful world!
ErpinRoyale_Affinity7: Do I still look like a fool to you, Master? If I do... then I suppose I just have to work even harder!
ErpinRoyale_LevelUp: I can still grow even stronger!
ErpinRoyale_Equipment: Wearing something impressive will make me look more dignified!
ErpinRoyale_HeroSkill: I never neglect my magic practice either~!
ErpinRoyale_HeroUpgrade: I still have a long way to go. You will stay with me until the end, right?
ErpinRoyale_DeckSetting1: Is it the Sprite Queen's turn?
ErpinRoyale_DeckSetting2: If you need my strength, just say so anytime!
ErpinRoyale_Stage: I have to show the Master how impressive I can be~!

ErpinRoyale_Touch1_1: Ow! I do not think I did anything wrong?!
ErpinRoyale_Touch2_1: Could you do this more often?
ErpinRoyale_Touch1_2: I understand! This is the Master's trial that Ner mentioned, right?
ErpinRoyale_Touch2: Master~ I am still a queen, you know~
ErpinRoyale_DutchRubEnd2: How long are you going to keep hitting me?!!
Item_HeroSkin_ErpinRoyale_Skin1: Nerpin, High Priest for a Day

ErpinRoyale_Growth2_Skin1: I am Ner, High Priest of the World Tree Order!

ErpinRoyale_Equipment_Skin1: So this is the kind of thing a High Priest uses!
ErpinRoyale_HeroSkill_Skin1: I just have to think about efficiency, right?
ErpinRoyale_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: All Apostles, heed the High Priest~!
ErpinRoyale_Board_Skin1: As the Master guides me~! Is that right?
ErpinRoyale_Touch1_Skin1: You are ruining the High Priest's dignity!!
ErpinRoyale_Touch1_2_Skin1: So the Master treats everyone equally...
ErpinRoyale_Touch2_1_Skin1: A hardworking High Priest naturally deserves this much praise!
ErpinRoyale_Touch2_2_Skin1: I am doing well, right? Praise me more!

ErpinRoyale_Growth2_Skin2: It is like confidence is welling up inside me! I am different from before!
ErpinRoyale_LevelUp_Skin2: I really can do everything well now! I am confident!

ErpinRoyale_HeroSkill_Skin2: From now on, I will study a lot and exercise even more!
ErpinRoyale_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: Mmm~ I will become an even better queen! From now on, always!
ErpinRoyale_Board_Skin2: Make way for the Queen of Erpien~! Hehe!
ErpinRoyale_Touch1_Skin2: Wah? Hey!! Do not pull so hard!
ErpinRoyale_Touch1_1_Skin2: Ngh... Even my patience has limits?!
ErpinRoyale_Touch1_2_Skin2: Sigh, is enduring this part of a queen's duty too?
ErpinRoyale_Touch2_Skin2: What? This is not preparation for pinching me... right? Hehe.
ErpinRoyale_Touch2_1_Skin2: Hehe! You want me to wait a little? When I grow bigger, I will pet you, Master!
ErpinRoyale_Touch2_2_Skin2: Huhehe... I look pretty today, right? Right?
ErpinRoyale_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Come on~ I really did not do anything wrong this time~!
ErpinRoyale_AsideGet: Another crown! That must mean I have become an even finer queen, right?
ErpinRoyale_AsideUpgrade: I will live up to everyone's hopes, so I can become a splendid queen.
ErpinRoyale_SPSkill1: Here I go! I have plenty more!
ErpinRoyale_Birthday: Master! Here is your birthday cake! Huh? Is it really that surprising to see the cake intact?
ErpinRoyale_Gacha3: I will lend you my strength! I am not the same as before!
ErpinRoyale_Line1: At last, I feel like a true queen whom everyone recognizes!
ErpinRoyale_Line2: I want to lend my strength to everyone, beginning with the Master!
ErpinRoyale_Line3: If bad people appear, I will teach them a lesson and set them straight!
ErpinRoyale_Lobby: Everyone seems to look up to me! It feels a little strange...
ErpinRoyale_EasterEgg_NerRageWith: Master! You can take your time thinking! I will keep waiting right here!
ErpinRoyale_ErpinDairy_Desc1: Sprites have reel bad tempers. Im the queen but they say stop eating bread. If Im the queen cant I eat all I want? I dont get why they put it out on the street looking so yummy and then say dont eat it. Im gonna sulk. But when I go to Ashurs, she smiles like a balloon with all the air gone and lets me eat bread. From now on Im only going to Ashurs bakery.
ErpinRoyale_ErpinDairy_Desc2: I made a freind when I went for a walk. She said she goes all over digging holes and collecting weird old stuff. She had lots of toys that go boom boom. She asked if there was anything expensive in my palace, so I said no. I took her to my room to look around, and she sighed real big and looked at me like she felt sorry for me. Why?
ErpinRoyale_ErpinDairy_Desc3: Ner said today was the day I had to say something important in the plaza. Polan and Ner and Big Sis Belita said they would come watch too. Scary. It was really scary but Ner said I had to do it anyway. She practiced with me all day too. But nobody came. Polan and Ner and Sis said thats just how these things are and it was okay. But Im not stupid. Thats not how these things are.
ErpinRoyale_ErpinDairy_Desc4: I think this was when I ran away. I went with Marie to play in the forest where the Werebeasts live. Diana got surprised and gave me lots of apples and strawberries and stuff. They werent as tasty as bread but I ate them because I was hungry. Some little Werebeasts outside were going somewhere to play, so I secretly followed them to join in, but then I got lost. I sat on the ground crying until night, and Ner came to find me with Diana. I told Ner I was sorry.
ErpinRoyale_ErpinDairy_Desc5: It started raining lots while I was going back to my room from Ashurs bakery. Sprites dont like getting wet, so everybody ran inside. I went under a roof thingy to stay out of the rain. I waited in the middle of the rainy street for a long time for it to stop. Then a tall Sprite walked back and forth looking nervous for ages before coming over. She gave me an umbrella and left. So I got back to my room without getting rained on.
ErpinRoyale_ErpinDairy_Desc6: I finally finished all my late diary pages. I feel proud. I promise I wont let them pile up anymore. Writing two months of diary pages all at once was way too hard. Starting tomorrow I will never ever fall behind and write every single day. Can I really do it? Hmm I dont know. Im not even good at listening to Sprite complaints in the kingdom... Ner said I have to start with little things like this and get better one step at a time. Sometimes it feels like a lot, but Im the queen so I have to do it, right? Ill work hard.
ErpinRoyale_ErpinDairy_Title3: I Hated It So I Cried
ErpinRoyale_ErpinDairy_Weather1: Maybe around last month? Weather sunny.
ErpinRoyale_ErpinDairy_Weather2: The week after last month. Weather cloudy.
ErpinRoyale_ErpinDairy_Weather3: Three weeks after that. Weather super shiny sunny.
ErpinRoyale_NerBabyBook_Desc1:
Order Management Log. October 12, Year 3 of the Erpien Calendar. Autumn. Clear skies.
Today, several bakers from Bakery Street arrived together to lodge a complaint. They said Her Majesty had once again eaten whatever she pleased at their bakeries without paying, then fled. They made a tremendous commotion demanding compensation from the Order, claiming she had devoured not only the bread displayed at the street stalls, but every loaf and cake inside the shops as well. I later explained the situation to Her Majesty and scolded her, but she did not appear to understand what I was saying. This is exhausting. The kingdom's coffers dried up long ago, and at this rate the Order's finances will not survive either. I shall have to sell some of the Order's real estate.
ErpinRoyale_NerBabyBook_Desc2:
Kingdom Log. September 22, Year 4 of the Erpien Calendar. Autumn. Cloudy.
It seems Her Majesty befriended a strange Sprite while she was outside. She called the Sprite a good friend and even brought her to the palace, but no matter how I looked at her, I could only see a suspicious swindler. I therefore observed them secretly as they played in Her Majesty's room, but less happened than I expected. The Sprite tapped and handled some of the pottery in the room, then wore a dissatisfied expression and seemed to give up on something. Her intentions appear dubious, but Her Majesty seems to think well of her, so I plan to leave the matter alone for now.
ErpinRoyale_NerBabyBook_Desc3:
Order Management Log. March 1, Year 5 of the Erpien Calendar. Spring. Clear skies.
Today was the anniversary of Her Majesty's founding of the kingdom. I posted a large notice on the plaza bulletin board and asked the guard to inform every Sprite that their attendance was required. Queen Belita of the Witch Kingdom also said she would attend, so I thought the atmosphere would not become as awkward as it did last year. We prepared plenty of food and decorated the plaza splendidly. But... And yet... It is too painful to continue writing. I shall end today's entry here.
ErpinRoyale_NerBabyBook_Desc4:
Kingdom Log. March 2, Year 5 of the Erpien Calendar. Spring. Cloudy.
We barely managed to find Her Majesty after she ran away. Had it not been for Chief Diana of the Werebeast Village, we could never have found her in that vast forest. After offering Chief Diana my deepest apologies and thanks, I brought Her Majesty back and trudged all the way to the kingdom. Captain Polan angrily demanded to know how I could have lost Her Majesty. Unable to say anything, I found myself sniffling. I intended to give Her Majesty a severe lecture that evening, but then she said she was sorry. I think that was enough.
ErpinRoyale_NerBabyBook_Desc5:
Kingdom Log. May 6, Year 5 of the Erpien Calendar. Spring. Rain.
Her Majesty returned to the palace soaked through after wandering outside in the rain. I thought my heart would break. She appeared to have found an umbrella somewhere, but when I tried to discard the shabby thing, she insisted it had been a precious gift and refused to hand it over. She placed it beside the strange rocks and rubbish piled in her room, then fell asleep for her afternoon nap. I secretly tidied everything and threw it all into the rubbish bin. When Her Majesty awoke, she wailed and frantically searched for the umbrella. Was it truly that important? Her Majesty refuses to explain why, so I do not know.
ErpinRoyale_NerBabyBook_Desc6:
Kingdom Log. June 21, Year 5 of the Erpien Calendar. Summer. Clear skies.
Her Majesty brought me her diary and asked me to inspect it. I am always the one scolding her, and this was the first time she had brought it to me of her own accord, so I felt a little proud. However, its contents were a complete jumble. It appears she secretly looked through the Order management logs and kingdom logs I write, opened them to random pages, and loosely imitated their contents. Looking back, I suppose such events may indeed have occurred, but I was so overwhelmed myself that the diary only left me confused. Still... this must mean she has improved a little, must it not? If she continues in this fashion, I have no doubt that one day she will become the finest queen of all.
LoveLetter_ErpinRoyale:
Hi, Master! It is me, Erpin!
A lot has happened since you came to Elias, right?
At first, I might have seemed inadequate and a little foolish...
But you stayed beside me, teaching and helping me.
And! Because you believed in me, I feel like I am becoming a true queen.

You will keep staying with me from now on, right?
Just as you gave me strength, I will be your strength too!
You know I am super strong, right? You can lean on me as much as you like!

From Erpin.
LoveCall_ErpinRoyale:
Master~! Are you still really busy?

I am very busy too, but I wanted to hear your voice, so I called!

Handling petitions and paperwork has always been difficult and unpleasant, but once I genuinely tried to work hard at them, they turned out to be even harder than I expected.

Still, the harder I work, the happier Ner and the kingdom's residents become, so I endure it even when it is tough.

You will praise me too, right, Master? You used to bonk me on the head a lot, but that was because I had done something wrong. Now I am genuinely doing well, so I want you to praise me.

I want to see you soon. Be sure to call me before you come to the palace. I will meet you at the entrance. Got it?

Please keep looking after me, Master! Let us do our best today too!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP01_001: I am going to try foods other than cake and bread now!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP01_002: How admirable! Tell me anything you want, and I will make it.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP01_003: Really?! Hooray! Then make me caramel popcorn~ chocolate ice cream~ and marshmallow macarons!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP01_004: Really? Did you find a new food you like?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP01_005: Hmm~ Not exactly. But when I complain about side dishes, it makes things difficult for Ner and everyone else! So I decided to work hard and try them!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP01_006: It will still be something sweet, will it not?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP01_007: Hmph! I still like sweet things much more, but... I truly am trying other foods too!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP02_001: Jade gave me a book recently, so I am studying! It is called 'Qualifications of a Queen'!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP02_002: What? Studying? I feel as though you will only add more doodles to the book...
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP02_003: I really am studying seriously! I only doodled a little!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP02_004: It sounds like a difficult book... Is your studying going well?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP02_005: Hmm~ Difficult words appear sometimes, but Ner helps me, so I can manage it!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP02_006: Really? Let us read and study it together next time!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP02_007: Hehe, good! I think I will concentrate better if I study with you, Master!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP03_001: I want to prepare a gift for Ner... but I do not know what would be good!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP03_002: A gift? Is today a special occasion?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP03_003: No, nothing like that... I feel as though I only ever receive things from Ner, so I wanted to give her something too!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP03_004: Ner will be happy! I will help you choose.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP03_005: Yes! Good! Let us walk around the Sprite Kingdom and choose together! Hehe, that sounds fun!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP03_006: A gift? It is not food again, is it?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP03_007: Huh? Food is not allowed? I was considering a delicious cake...
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP04_001: Last time, I realized I had become a true queen and started crying by myself. But Heidi says she filmed it! Ugh, how embarrassing...
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP04_002: At times like this, eat something delicious and forget about it!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP04_003: Ugh, really? Then, Master! Give me seven servings of the most delicious thing here!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP04_004: Oh, I must be sure to read this issue of the newspaper.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP04_005: N-No! I said it was embarrassing! Do not look at it under any circumstances, understood?!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP04_006: You cried because you were happy. I thought it was a lovely sight.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP04_007: Well... I was very happy. If you thought it was lovely, Master... perhaps I do not mind after all. Hehe.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP05_001: Hehe, I want to eat the cake Ashur gave me again!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP05_002: Please order only items listed on the menu.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP05_003: What? I am not ordering! I was only saying it tasted good. That soft, fluffy texture was a work of art~!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP05_004: Ashur seemed to put a great deal of effort into preparing it.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP05_005: R-Really? Hmm... I should thank Ashur properly next time!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP05_006: It must have been delicious. I should learn how to make it next time.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP05_007: Huh? Wait. Now that I think about it, if I learn the recipe, I can make and eat it whenever I want! Me too! I am coming too!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP06_002: Hmm... It might be better with a slightly different design.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP06_003: R-Really? I like it... What part would you change, and how?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP06_005: Really?! What a relief! The crown is beautiful, but I always worried that I, its queen, might not suit it... Hehe.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP06_006: It will come to suit you in time.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP06_007: Y-Yes! That is right! I will strive to become a queen who suits not only the crown, but the Sprite Kingdom too!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP07_001: I am considering new benefits for the citizens of the Sprite Kingdom. What would be good?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP07_002: That is a difficult question. Let us discuss it with Ner.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP07_003: Yes! It does not seem like something we can solve with a little thought. Phew~ A queen's work... I realize anew that it is not simple at all!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP07_004: No. You should reduce the benefits instead!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP07_005: Wh-What~? That is too cruel! I want our citizens to be happy!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP07_006: What else? Let us distribute cake everywhere!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP07_007: Good idea! ...Wait, no! It sounds delicious, but would that not overwork everyone who makes the cakes?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP08_002: Why do you suddenly need my diary?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP08_003: Well... You always take good care of the citizens, Master, so I want to learn from you. I will read only a little and return it. Please~
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP08_004: Are you going to submit mine for another homework inspection?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP08_005: N-No! I do my homework properly now! I-I fall a little behind sometimes...
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP08_006: All right, I will lend it to you. Take good care of it and return it.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP08_007: Yes! Thank you! The citizens must follow you so well because you have such a generous heart, right? I will follow your example!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP09_001: I have been doing fitness training with Polan lately!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP09_002: Huh? Did physical education classes begin again?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP09_003: No! Supervising my class would leave Polan less time to train, so I join in beside her when she trains.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP09_004: Oh, how admirable. Can you handle the training?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP09_005: Yes! It is still difficult to copy her form, but I am working hard! Polan has always trained like this. She truly is impressive!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP09_006: Can you keep up with Polan's training?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP09_007: What do you take me for, Master? I may not look it, but I always earned a perfect score on practical physical education tests!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP10_001: Hmm... What can I do to help everyone get along?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP10_002: You do not have to get along with absolutely everyone, do you?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP10_003: Of course some people may dislike one another... but I still wish everyone could get along.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP10_004: I do not know yet either. Let us discover the answer together.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP10_005: Yes...! Let us work hard together! Hehe, this has troubled me for so long. Having you here reassures me, Master!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP10_006: Indeed. I would like to know the answer too.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP10_007: There are things even you do not know, Master? Hmm, it must not be a simple problem after all.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP11_001: What do you think about employing Marie at the royal palace?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP11_003: Manager of the underground passages! Marie is good at digging holes, so would she not do well?!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP11_005: Master, Marie is growing in her own way too! Is it not natural for a queen to trust her citizens?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP11_006: Her hands are skillful, so she could be a great help.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP11_007: Exactly! And being with Marie is fun! Hehe.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP12_001: Ugh~ I cannot endure it any longer! Master! Let us go out and have fun!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP12_002: You mean after you finish all your work, right?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP12_003: Th-That is... Hmph! I want to rest too! Would it hurt to play with me sometimes?!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP12_004: Wh-What brought this on? Did something happen?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP12_005: It has been far too long since I went out with you, Master! That time is essential to me!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP12_006: Good! Everyone needs to rest properly sometimes.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP12_007: Really?! Hooray~! I will pack at once! Hehe, I finally get to go out with you again, Master~!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP13_001: Eating while preserving my dignity is still difficult!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP13_002: I like seeing you eat heartily as you do now.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP13_003: Really?! Hehe, I knew you were the best, Master! Then give me one strawberry cake! I will show you right here!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP13_004: You are still a queen. You should maintain some dignity.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP13_005: Ugh, is treating everyone kindly not enough? I want to eat however I please, at least!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP13_006: Changing too suddenly will make you sick. Take it slowly.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP13_007: Right, right? I am a Sprite too. It is only natural to get a little cream and a few bread crumbs around my mouth!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP14_001: Someday, I want to become a magnificent queen like my sister.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP14_002: That may take quite a while.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP14_003: I-I know! Becoming a magnificent queen like her is difficult. ...Will it truly take that long?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP14_004: There is no need to compare yourself. You are magnificent in your own way.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP14_005: M-Master... Sniff, yes...! Thank you! I will keep striving to become an even finer queen!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP14_007: First, I will go ask my sister directly! Then I will observe carefully how she usually treats the citizens!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP15_001: Master, Master! I passed my dictation test!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP15_002: What?! You must have worked very hard at cheating?!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP15_003: Hmph, Master! I took it fairly this time! If you do not believe me, ask me a question now!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP15_004: What?! How easy were the questions?!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP15_005: They were not! They were just as difficult! If only they had asked about the coasters I studied, I would have set a new record...!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP15_007: Fifty! That is forty-five points higher than last time. Ner says I do not need another retest before the next exam!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP16_001: Elena says that when life tastes bitter, coffee begins to taste sweet. Is it like that for you too, Master?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP16_002: I use coffee instead of sugar in my food.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP16_003: Wh-What~?! How bitter is your life?! Master, are you truly all right...?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP16_004: Hah. You are still too young for coffee.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP16_005: Hmph, do not treat me like a child! I can drink it perfectly well if I add about ten sugar cubes!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP16_006: Sometimes? To be honest, I do not understand it well either.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP16_007: Neither do I! Without sugar it is still far too bitter for me. Will the day ever come when I can taste that sweetness too?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP17_001: Master, you know... I want to create a new combat technique of my own!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP17_003: Ooh! I do not know what that is, but it sounds convincing! I think inspiration has struck. Thank you, Master!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP17_004: Do it outside. Do not break everything here again.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP17_005: Who said I would do it here?! Shall I develop a truly enormous technique just to show you?!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP17_006: A combat technique? Why so suddenly?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP17_007: I have to become stronger to protect the citizens! Is there no more powerful technique? Ugh, this is difficult!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP18_001: Do you have any worries, Master? I will listen!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP18_002: The Sprite Queen has been causing trouble lately...
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP18_003: What?! I shall teach her a... Wait, I am the Sprite Queen!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP18_004: Dealing with leftovers in the Banquet Hall...
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP18_005: Hah, leftovers? I will dispose of them! Where are they? Bring me as much as you like!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP18_006: How to help everyone get along...
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP18_007: H-Huh? That is what I am worrying about too. Sorry, Master. I cannot solve it immediately... but let us consider it together!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP19_001: Is it not difficult to run the Banquet Hall alone? Should I help?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP19_002: I am accustomed to it... I can endure it.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP19_003: Ugh... Becoming accustomed to hardship is too sad! I will help too, all right? What should I do first?!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP19_004: Oh? Then let us begin with washing the dishes!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP19_005: Huh? W-Washing dishes? I thought you would let me cook?! Washing dishes does not look fun...
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP19_006: It is all right because you visit me sometimes.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP19_007: Really?! Then I will visit even more often! So do not work yourself too hard, all right?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP20_001: Tomorrow, Butter and I are going for a walk in the forest!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP20_002: Really? Should I pack you a lunch?
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP20_003: Oh, yes! Please include strawberry cake~ and the caramel popcorn Butter likes!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP20_004: A queen's duties must leave you with plenty of free time.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP20_005: What? This is a proper duty too! It is for building friendly relations with the Beastfolk!
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP20_006: Be careful not to lose your crown again.
Affinity_ErpinRoyale_EP20_007: O-Of course! I will not be caught by another dangling trap like that!
